## 1. Admissibility.-  
Family pension is payable to the family of a Government servant if he  
dies-  
- (i)
- after completion of one year of continuous service; or
- (ii) before completion of one year of continuous service, provided immediately prior to his appointment to the service or post, he/she was examined by the appropriate medical authority and declared fit by that authority for Government service; or
